repair.title: Fewer Adults Use Tobacco
repair.summary: WHO estimates that about 1 in 5 adults used tobacco in 2022, down from about 1 in 3 in 2000.
repair.why_it_matters: Taxes, warnings, smoke-free rules, and cessation support can shift a huge public-health risk.
repair.caveat: Tobacco still kills millions each year, and industry pressure keeps the problem alive.
